steps.eval: (async () => { const cols=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>{const cs=getComputedStyle(e);return (cs.overflowX==='auto'||cs.overflowX==='scroll')&&e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+40&&/Lead|Contacted|Quote/.test(e.textContent||'')}); const c=cols[cols.length-1]; if(!c) return; const start=c.scrollLeft,end=c.scrollWidth-c.clientWidth,dur=4200,t0=performance.now(); await new Promise(res=>{const step=(n)=>{const p=Math.min((n-t0)/dur,1); c.scrollLeft=start+(end-start)*(p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2); p<1?requestAnimationFrame(step):res();}; requestAnimationFrame(step);}); })()
